meta.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me
meta.description: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

videos.title: Act 1: A Renowned Actor Becomes a Nobody
videos.overview: Gen Takasegawa triumphs as the first Japanese lead at Shakespeare's Globe. But when he returns home, a startling reality awaits: no one knows who he is.

videos.title: Act 2: A Renowned Actor Receives Some Lines
videos.overview: Stripped of his fame and identity, Gen takes a job at a rundown sauna — and gets his first brutal lesson in what it means to be ordinary.

videos.title: Act 3: A Renowned Actor Rents a Room
videos.overview: A familiar face from Gen's past resurfaces — but the reunion is anything but warm. Meanwhile, a late-night TV shoot at the sauna tests everyone's limits.

videos.title: Act 4: A Renowned Actor Uses a Stage Name
videos.overview: Gen meets Okamoto's troupe, adopts the stage name Taku Tanaka — and discovers his estranged daughter is working at a concept cafe. He starts showing up.

videos.title: Act 5: A Renowned Actor Goes to Kyoto
videos.overview: A job in Kyoto brings Gen face to face with his father's legacy — and forces him to confront the shadow he spent his whole career running from.

videos.title: Act 6: A Renowned Actor Blows His Fuse and Goes Viral
videos.overview: On set, Gen discovers he's not the only actor the world forgot. But when he has to work with an old flame, his hard-won composure starts to crack.

videos.title: Act 7: A Renowned Actor Goes Back to Square One
videos.overview: With a career-defining opportunity within reach, Gen bares his soul to the world. Whether the world is ready to listen is another matter entirely.

videos.title: Act 8: A Renowned Actor Is Reborn
videos.overview: Gen's stage comeback takes a detour he never saw coming. As opening night looms, chaos mounts — and everything rides on one small stage.
